references.text: Direct narrative precursor: The verse explains the occasion (illness) that led Joseph to bring his sons forward.
Thematic parallel: Shows the continuity of the blessing from its institution to the birth of grandchildren.
Action and interpretation: Verse 20 explains the theological consequence of the positioning in verse 13.
Prophetic allusion: Ezekiel builds on the tribal identity established in Genesis 48 to speak about future reunification.
